ladder.label: UPTREND
ladder.why: Day 19 of the cycle, trend intact above a rising 10-day average, weekly still mixed. Last cycle was left-translated (topped early) — a bearish structural tell.
ladder.next: Hold; first warning would be losing the 10-day average, bigger warning is a daily momentum cross down.
ladder.regime_why: weekly momentum just crossed up; 3-day crossed up; investor cycle failed (broke its start low); investor cycle overdue; last cycle left-translated (topped early)
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: BEARISH — weekly momentum just crossed up; 3-day crossed up; investor cycle failed (broke its start low); investor cycle overdue; last cycle left-translated (topped early) (investor cycle week 30 · failed · daily cycle day 19).
points: Bigger picture is bearish (counter-trend for a daily long)
Macro: US net liquidity contracting — caution on the odds
Swing low printed (buyers rejected the low)
Back above the 10-day average, and it's turning up
Prior cycle topped early (a tiring-trend hint)

entry.text: Trend intact — hold; add on dips toward the 10-day average.
entry.text_zh: 趋势完好——持有；可在回调至 10 日均线附近时加仓。

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 19 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 19 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日
cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 30 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: overdue — the bigger cycle is stretched, expect more volatility
cycle_plain.weekly_line_zh: 周线（投资者）周期：第 30 周，典型周期为 16–26 周
cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 逾期——更大的周期已被拉伸，预计波动加剧
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its FIRST half ('left-translated') — weak cycles top early, so this hints the bigger trend is tiring.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在前半段见顶（“左移”）——弱周期见顶偏早，这暗示更大的趋势正在走弱。

ladder.early_note: ⚡ Early topping signs (heads-up): MACD histogram rolled over off a peak (pre-cross). These anticipate a high BEFORE confirmation — a heads-up to protect gains, not a sell trigger yet.
ladder.why_zh: 周期第 19 天，趋势完好并位于向上的 10 日均线之上，周线仍为混合。 上一周期为左移结构（见顶偏早）——属于看空的结构性信号。
ladder.next_zh: 持有；首个预警是失守 10 日均线，更大的预警是日线动量向下交叉。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：看空 — 周线动量刚刚向上交叉；3 日线向上交叉；投资者周期失败（跌破起始低点）；投资者周期已逾期；上一周期左移（见顶偏早）（投资者周期第 30 周 · 已失败 · 日线周期第 19 天）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：上涨趋势。大局（逆势）：看空。
points_zh: 大局为看空（对日线多头而言属逆势）
宏观：美国净流动性收缩——对概率属需谨慎
摆动低点已现（买方拒绝了该低点）
重新站上 10 日均线之上，且均线开始向上
上一周期见顶偏早（趋势走弱的暗示）
ladder.early_note_zh: ⚡ 提前出现的做顶迹象（heads-up）：MACD histogram rolled over off a peak (pre-cross)。这些信号会在确认之前预判高点——属于保护利润的提示，而非卖出触发信号。
ladder.liq_line: Macro headwind: US net liquidity is contracting — buy setups have historically had worse odds and deeper drawdowns here, so demand extra confirmation and smaller size. An odds edge, not a forecast.
ladder.liq_line_zh: 宏观逆风：美国净流动性正在收缩——在此环境下买入形态历史上胜率更低、回撤更深，因此应要求更多确认并降低仓位。这是概率优势，并非预测。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ UPTREND signal triggered 6 trading days ago (~2026-06-09), switching from NEARING A LOW. Signal strength: mild (score +39/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 上涨趋势信号于 6 个交易日前触发（约 2026-06-09），自接近低点切换而来。 信号强度：温和（评分 +39/100）。
ladder.eq_label: Entry quality: minimal no clean setup (+11)
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：微弱无明确形态（+11）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle low, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期低点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。
